flows.title: Create a form
steps: On your My Workspace page, click Create on the top-left of the screen.
In the window that opens, click Form.
Choose Start from Scratch, or Use Template to pick one of Jotform's templates.
Under the Form Elements menu on the left, take the fields you need from the Basic tab, such as Name, Email, Short Text, Long Text and Multiple Choice.
Drag and drop each element onto the form, scrolling the list for the rest.

flows.title: Be emailed when someone fills in a form
steps: In Form Builder, click Settings in the orange navigation bar at the top of the page.
In the menu on the left side of the page, click Emails.
Click the Recipients tab and enter your own email address in the Recipient Email field.
